title: Automatic Bank Draft Relief on Reinstated Security Deposits
content:
Members who pay their Electric Service by Rate Schedule bills by automatic bank draft receive relief on the reinstatement multiple of a Security Deposits deposit reinstated on the waiver reinstatement basis.

## Terms

The autopay relief is the full autopay relief of **0.15** when every service payment on the reinstated account in the last twelve months came by automatic bank draft, the half autopay relief of **0.05** when at least half but not all of them did, and nothing otherwise. An account with no service payment in the last twelve months receives no autopay relief. The autopay relief is taken off the reinstatement multiple. The reinstatement multiple is never below **1.0**; that floor is applied once, to the multiple as finally reckoned.

## The terms in a table

| Service payments on the reinstated account in the last twelve months | Autopay relief |
|---|---|
| at least one, and every one by automatic bank draft | 0.15 |
| at least half, but not all, by automatic bank draft | 0.05 |
| fewer than half by automatic bank draft | nothing |
| no service payment | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

| Service payments | Of which by bank draft | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 12 | 0.15 |
| 12 | 6 | 0.05 |
| 12 | 11 | 0.05 |
| 12 | 5 | nothing |
